description: Read how much SOL a Solana wallet can reclaim from rent: the deposits parked in its empty token accounts, and the surplus the rent cut left in accounts it still uses. Returns counts and net figures in SOL. Nothing is closed or moved.

address.description: The Solana wallet address to read (base58 public key). Public data only; no connection or signature is involved.

name: check_reclaimable_rent
title: Check reclaimable rent
